unavailable.notFound: Project not found or you have no access.
unavailable.archived: The project is archived and does not accept import.
unavailable.noPermission: You do not have permission to import tickets in this project.

header.title: Import list
header.intro: Paste a Markdown list: each item becomes a ticket, the indentation says who is whose child. Optional markers set the status of the tickets.

input.label: List
input.placeholder:
- First delivery
  - [x] Completed step
  - [/] Step in progress
- [ ] Another delivery

preview.title: Preview
preview.empty: The tree appears here while you paste or type the list.

linear.title: Import from Linear
linear.intro: Bring the issues of the Linear team linked to this project. The import only reads Linear; nothing is written there.
linear.actingAs: While acting as someone else, the Linear import is not available: the key is personal. Go back to being yourself.

unlinked.title: This project is not linked to Linear yet
unlinked.canLink: Link the project to a Linear team in Settings → Linear. The link is permanent, and it is what avoids duplicating issues in a later import.
unlinked.cannotLink: A project administrator needs to link it to a Linear team, in Settings → Linear.

noKey.title: Your Linear key is missing
noKey.body: To import into this project, connect your key for the {{workspace}} workspace in Settings → Linear.

wrongKey.title: Your key does not work for this project
wrongKey.body: It is linked to the {{team}} team of the {{workspace}} workspace. In Settings → Linear, use a key from that workspace that can see the team.

linear.how: The import moves in short steps. If the tab closes, it continues where it stopped when someone comes back to this screen. If Linear asks to wait, the screen shows the time it comes back.
linear.waiting: Linear asked to wait. The import resumes at {{time}}.
linear.retrying: Linear did not respond. Trying again shortly…
linear.gaveUp: Linear did not respond and the import stopped. What was already imported stays; it continues where it stopped.

done.title: Import finished
done.assigneeEmailUnavailable: Linear did not let us read the assignees' e-mails; nobody was assigned.
done.flattenedNote: Flattened: placed one level above the original because of the tree depth limit.
done.skippedNote: Skipped: could not be linked to their parents (for example, a cycle in the hierarchy).
done.keptTouched: Kept because they were edited here
done.filled_one: {{count}} field filled in a ticket that already existed
done.filled_other: {{count}} fields filled in tickets that already existed
done.descriptionUnavailable: Some descriptions were too large and were not read again.
done.missingNotChecked: Could not check what disappeared, because some items came in an invalid format.
done.assigneeEmailUnavailableReimport: Linear did not allow reading the assignees’ e-mails; assignees were not updated.

abandon.confirmBody: What was already imported stays in the project. This import stops here and you can start another one later.

last.title: Last import · {{when}}
last.rule: Syncing only updates what changed in Linear and nobody touched here, does not move what was reorganized in the tree, and what disappeared from Linear stays as it is.

categorize.title: Arrange in the tree
categorize.intro_one: {{count}} item that came from Linear is still where the import put it. The AI can look for its place in the tree. When in doubt, the item stays where it is, marked for you to check.
categorize.intro_other: {{count}} items that came from Linear are still where the import put them. The AI can look for the place of each one in the tree. When in doubt, the item stays where it is, marked for you to check.
categorize.batchNote: That is {{total}} items; this round looks for the {{limit}} oldest and the rest waits for the next one.
categorize.start_one: Look for the place of {{count}} item
categorize.start_other: Look for the place of {{count}} items
categorize.sends: Sent to the AI: title and description of those tickets, the titles of what is inside them, and the project tree (titles and excerpts).
categorize.noConsent: To look for the items' places, the organization needs to turn on the AI assistant.
categorize.notConfigured: The AI is not configured in this environment, so the items' places cannot be searched.
categorize.waiting: The AI asked to wait. The search resumes at {{time}}.
categorize.retrying: The AI did not answer. Trying again shortly…
categorize.retryingStepFailed: A step of the search failed with an unexpected error. Trying again shortly…
categorize.retryingRateLimited: The AI reached its usage limit for now. Trying again shortly…
categorize.gaveUp: The search stopped because the server did not answer. What was already decided stays; it continues where it stopped.

abandon.confirmBody: What was already decided stays as it is. A new search only handles what is left.

categorize.reimportBlocked: Syncing is unavailable while the search for the items' places is running.

announce.done: Search for the items' places finished.
